title: Dynamics 365 Business Central – How to proportionally split costs across Dimensions using Statistical Accounts and Allocation Accounts
summary: This post explains how to automatically split costs across cost center dimensions in Business Central using Statistical Accounts and Allocation Accounts. It demonstrates a scenario where heating expenses are distributed proportionally to departments based on square footage, streamlining accurate cost allocation without manual intervention.
key_points: Statistical Accounts store non-financial metrics like square footage that drive cost allocation calculations
Allocation Accounts use Statistical Account data to automatically distribute costs across selected dimensions
When posting purchase invoices to an Allocation Account, the system proportionally splits amounts based on dimension values stored in the Statistical Account
Updating the Statistical Account journal automatically applies new allocation proportions to future transactions without reconfiguring the Allocation Account
